(assert (<= x_0_0 x_0_0))
(assert (<= x_0_0 x_0_1))
(assert (<= x_0_0 x_0_2))
(assert (<= x_0_0 x_1_0))
(assert (<= x_0_0 x_1_1))
(assert (<= x_0_0 x_1_2))
(assert (<= x_0_0 x_2_0))
(assert (<= x_0_0 x_2_1))
(assert (<= x_0_0 x_2_2))
(assert (<= x_0_1 x_0_2))
(assert (<= x_1_0 x_2_0))

(check-sat)
